definitions.gloss: blood pressure monitor; blood pressure gauge
definitions.explanation: A medical device used to measure blood pressure. Available in both professional clinical models and home-use digital versions.

examples.japanese: {血圧計|けつあつけい}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{測|はか}って→測る：01977_hakaru⟧⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please measure with the blood pressure monitor.

examples.japanese: ⟦{家庭用|かていよう}→家庭用：16544_kateiyou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{血圧計|けつあつけい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{買|か}った→買う：00489_kau⟧。
examples.english: I bought a home blood pressure monitor.

examples.japanese: ⟦{医師|いし}→医師：11851_ishi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{勧|すす}められて→勧める：02120_susumeru⟧、⟦{毎朝|まいあさ}→毎朝：00966_maiasa⟧{血圧計|けつあつけい}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{血圧|けつあつ}→血圧：00218_ketsuatsu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{記録|きろく}している→記録する：25341_kirokusuru⟧。
examples.english: On my doctor's recommendation, I record my blood pressure every morning with a blood pressure monitor.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{血圧|けつあつ}→血圧：00218_ketsuatsu⟧ (blood pressure) and ⟦{計|けい}→計：02691_kei⟧ (gauge, meter). The suffix ⟦{計|けい}→計：02691_kei⟧ is productive and appears in many instrument names such as ⟦{体温計|たいおんけい}→体温計：05484_taionkei⟧ (thermometer) and ⟦{体重計|たいじゅうけい}→体重計：05485_taijuukei⟧ (scale).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {血圧計|けつあつけい}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{測|はか}る→測る：01977_hakaru⟧ (to measure with a blood pressure monitor)
- ⟦{家庭用|かていよう}→家庭用：16544_kateiyou⟧{血圧計|けつあつけい} (home blood pressure monitor)
- ⟦{手首|てくび}→手首：01000_tekubi⟧{式|しき}{血圧計|けつあつけい} (wrist-type blood pressure monitor)
- ⟦{上腕|じょうわん}→上腕：29742_jouwan⟧{式|しき}{血圧計|けつあつけい} (upper arm-type blood pressure monitor)
